Subject: Finlytics POC — small ask: pause + sandbox access extension

Hi Lauren,

Quick note from our side: our engineering team hit a blocker with the new SFTP connector that blocks end-to-end testing. We were hoping to finish the last two integration stories this week but an upstream library regression has forced a rollback and a short rework.

We really like the trial throughput and the model behavior we've seen — the product side is ready to push to an exec review once we have a clean run. To avoid losing momentum with our stakeholders could you help with a short pause/extension on the sandbox access and trial credits (14 days)? Procurement wants a simple confirmation from you for their records.

I attached a small excerpt of the connector logs and a short note from our eng lead. We can provide a timeline by EOD Monday after the rollback.

Ask summary:
- 14-day extension on sandbox access and trial credits
- Keep current quota and API keys active during the pause
- One short call if you want engineering to walk through the blocker

Thanks for checking this — Alex

--
Alex Chen

alex.chen@finlytics.com

Forwarding the log excerpt — thanks for flagging this, Alex. Quick tech read: the logs show a transient SFTP handshake failure correlated with the lib-crypto 2.1.7 -> 2.2.0 bump. Our webhook retry is idempotent but their client replays caused duplicate manifest writes which then surfaced as checksum mismatches.

What I recommend for a smooth retest:
- Keep keys active (agreed)
- Temporarily increase webhook retry backoff from 2s to 8s for the Finlytics sandbox route (we can scope this change and quickly revert after the POC)
- Enable a short-lived log level debug flag for the route during their re-test window so they can confirm the handshake aligns with their updated library

I can roll the change today and schedule a 30-minute sync with their eng lead if helpful. If they opt for the rollback instead of the patch, the extension as Lauren outlined should be fine — we won’t revoke any tokens.

— Kim
Principal Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference
